additional_info.subject: ID0456256-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312562229/29] Charging below 100 Kw CRM:03056000221
additional_info.body:
Dear Bastien
Following your request and after our analysis, we observed that at the beginning of the charging session,
As you can see in the logs that I sent you in the screenshots the EV was requesting a high power level. The charger was managing all the modules in the group to deliver this power — up to around 300 kW
However, after a few minutes, we noticed that the EV was no longer able to accept more than 60 kW. In other words, the vehicle was not capable of receiving the power it was initially requesting.
As a result, the charger automatically reconfigured the module group to match the actual power that the EV was able to accept.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
